cohort: 12 women with acromegaly who completed pregnancy
finding: Pregnancy in women with acromegaly appears to be generally safe for both mother and baby, and biochemical control of acromegaly may improve during pregnancy.
gest_age: Term for 15 pregnancies, 32 weeks for 1 pregnancy (pre-eclampsia), and 35 weeks for 1 twin pregnancy (elective C-section)
